matchId.description: The planned match; absent for a quick match started on the watch, for which the server makes a match.

device.description: What recorded it: the watch app and the watch, for example garmin:006-B3703-00 (a Garmin part number), wearos:SM-R860 (the model) or applewatch:Watch7,3 (the hardware identifier; applewatch:Apple Watch from apps before it).

penalties.description: Shoot-out score, when there was one.

goldenGoal.description: The match ended on a golden goal in extra time (ET-6): the team that scored it won.

stoppingClock.description: The match was played on a clock that stops (TMR-15), as US high school and college games are: events' times are the clock's, its stoppages are when it stood still, and there was no added time, so the added-time stats leave the match out (STAT-9).

distanceM.description: Distance the referee covered during the match, in meters, from the watch's GPS.

kickoffDirection.description: Which way the first period's kickoff team attacked, when the referee recorded it on the watch (PRE-8); heatmaps use it (TRK-9).

team.description: The team that kicked off the first period.

bearingDeg.description: The compass bearing of the goal it attacked, in degrees from true north.

editedAt.description: When its result was last corrected after the match (RES-1); set by the server whenever the outcome, score, shoot-out, golden goal or events change. A watch's later upload of the same match then changes nothing (RES-4).

original.description: The result exactly as the watch first sent it, kept by the server the first time it's corrected (RES-3), so it can be shown or put back. Absent for results entered without a watch.

id.description: The id from the URL; can be left out.

version.description: The version last seen, when updating. Leave it out to create the record.

description: A MatchRecord as a client sends it to save it: the server sets updatedAt and deletedAt, and version only goes with an update.
